examples.title: Reading a Pictograph
examples.problem: In a chart, 1 book icon = 2 books. If there are 5 icons next to 'Raju', how many books does he have?
examples.explanation: Identify the number of symbols and multiply by the value assigned in the key.

examples.title: Using Tally Marks
examples.problem: Show the number 13 using tally marks.
examples.solution: Two groups of 5 and 3 extra lines (|||| / |||| / |||).
examples.explanation: Tally marks group data in 5s for easier counting.

examples.title: Interpreting Results
examples.problem: A graph shows 20 sunny days and 10 cloudy days in a month. What fraction of the month was sunny?
examples.explanation: Data can be used to form fractions and ratios.
